notes:
### Added
- MacOS menu bar icon with quick device actions.
- Rename, move and delete actions in Files Explorer for Android and iOS.
- Option to open Apple Device Hub from iOS device actions.
- Option to open devices running iOS 27 or later in macOS Screen Sharing.
- Advanced screen mirroring of physical devices running iOS 27 or later.
- Build watching, with a notification when the build starts and when it finishes.
- MCP tool `list_build_configurations` to list the build configurations of the TeamCity project.
- Forget button for disconnected devices.

### Changed
- Redesigned the Builds page, with a much simpler and intuitive UX.
- MCP tool `trigger_teamcity_build` to require `buildConfigurationId`. The `platform` and `buildType` arguments are removed. The tool accepts only ids from `list_build_configurations`.
- Bundled pymobiledevice3 version from v11.12.5 to v11.20.1.

### Fixed
- Build times displaying with the time zone of the TeamCity server instead of the local time zone.
- Cancelled builds showing as failed.
- Devices with no name or model staying in the device list.
